name: intimate-blurry-motion-selfie
image_purpose: Authentic pet-lifestyle memory and raw gallery post

prompt.project_info: Create a raw low-resolution vertical smartphone selfie of an approved adult woman reclining on a cream sofa with a black cat, preserving organic motion blur and accidental-gallery realism.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long slightly messy brown hair and simple light casual clothing, looking softly toward the lens while a black cat with bright eyes rests close against her cheek and jaw on the cream leather sofa.
prompt.composition_elements: Very tight awkward front-camera close-up, woman and cat faces overlapping naturally, sofa filling the background, uneven organic motion blur concentrated on face, hair, and fur. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Indoor room lights at night, mildly overexposed highlights without losing facial structure, flat noisy skin texture, chroma noise, mild color banding, muddy shadows, no beautification.
prompt.technical_specs: Low-resolution smartphone front-camera look, wide-angle edge distortion, slow shutter and weak autofocus, inconsistent focus, soft smearing rather than artificial blur, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Raw unedited vertical 9:16 low-resolution smartphone selfie of an approved adult woman with long slightly messy brown hair and simple light casual clothing, reclining on a cream leather sofa while a black cat with bright eyes rests close against her cheek and jaw. Very tight accidental composition, faces and fur overlapping naturally, organic uneven motion blur from weak autofocus and slight hand movement, low-light indoor room at night, ISO and chroma noise, mild banding, muddy shadows, subtle overexposed highlights, wide-angle edge distortion, no beauty filter or AI enhancement.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, animal harm, high resolution, sharp focus, DSLR, cinematic lighting, studio lighting, ultra-detail, clean skin, beauty filter, HDR, professional photo, artificial perfect blur, bokeh, AI enhancement, extra fingers, watermark

assets.name: intimate-blurry-motion-selfie.jpg
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult, black cat, cream sofa, close overlap, organic blur, night lighting, and accidental phone-gallery quality.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve adult identity, pet, sofa, clothing, overlap, blur pattern, and low-light imperfections. People, pet, and room may be replaced only while retaining the same raw pet-selfie relationship. Do not invent typography or logos.
